impact.text: Permanent loss of funds - Truncated rewards are not recoverable.

precondition_sources.text: Total shares can be up to 800 million (8e26) in a fully sold out bonding curve.
The distributor contract has a non-zero pendingBaseRewards or pendingQuoteRewards.
The GTELaunchpadV2Pair contract continuously adds small reward amounts to the distributor as swap fees.

intent_sources.text: Reward distribution must not truncate pending rewards to zero; when pendingRewards * PRECISION_FACTOR is less than totalShares, the reward amounts must not be permanently lost.
